audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Urgot wins Level 6 while phases[4].why and whys[4] both describe Sylas taking over at 6 (Hijack online). Packet levelChart also lists Sylas at row 4.
audit.why: Sylas R (80/55/30s) steals Fear Beyond Death, a 2500-range impale + execute; that is a genuine swing at 6 and both layers' prose already say so.
audit.corrected: Row 4 (Level 6) flipped to Sylas in both layers, rating 3/10 -> 6/10.

audit.why: Spikes are Lvl 1-2 Echoing Flames, Lvl 6 Hijack, Riftmaker, and late full-build Urgot — four entries present and correctly timed.
audit.corrected: Text of spikes[0] and spikes[3] rewritten to use Echoing Flames and rank-5 Purge (free, 0s cooldown) instead of the invented 'shotgun knees (W passive)'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content repeatedly attributed Urgot's leg blasts to 'shotgun knees (W passive)' and called them percent-max-HP / 'true-DPS'. Riot's text puts the blasts on the passive Echoing Flames and calls the damage physical, with no percent-health flag on the ability. 'Urgot's R only executes targets below 25% HP' states a number Riot's description does not give.
audit.why: Wrong ability slot and an unverifiable damage type mislead the whole trading plan; Disdain's real properties (shield on the charge, displacement on a champion hit, 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s) are the actual matchup pivot and were never stated.
audit.corrected: Echoing Flames (P) named as the source of the leg blasts; percent-max-HP and true-damage claims removed; Disdain described as shield-plus-throw with its 16s rank-1 cooldown; rank-5 Purge noted as free and effectively off cooldown; execute threshold referred to without inventing a number.

audit.why: Disdain is 16s at rank 1, dropping only to 14s at rank 5.
Packet flagged wants.you[2] 'Steal Fear Beyond Death' as a suspect name; the kit confirms Fear Beyond Death is Urgot's real R. False positive, left alone.

edits.before: Urgot's shotgun knees tick percent-max-HP on his level-1 autos — you have no W heal yet and every step toward the wave costs more HP than Q poke returns.
edits.after: Urgot's Echoing Flames (P) adds leg blasts to his level-1 autos — you have no W heal yet and every step toward the wave costs more HP than Q poke returns.

edits.before: Disdain (E) comes online before yours and the flip into point-blank Purge shreds you before W can compensate — he dictates every early trade.
edits.after: Disdain (E) shields him as he charges and hurls you into point-blank Purge; at 16s rank 1 he holds it for your step-up — he dictates every early trade.

edits.before: At full build Urgot's HP stack and sustained percent damage outpaces your healing entirely; your value is stealing his R in teamfights, not winning the solo lane duel.
edits.after: At full build his HP stack and Echoing Flames leg blasts outpace your healing entirely; your value is stealing his 70-second R in teamfights, not winning the solo duel.

edits.before: Urgot's shotgun knees (W passive) proc on every auto and chunk you through your Q approach — his percent-max-HP damage ignores your healing before you have W online.
edits.after: Echoing Flames (P) blasts fire off his autos and off Purge, chunking you through your Q approach — his leg damage outpaces your poke before you have the W heal online.

edits.before: Urgot's percent-max-HP shotgun legs and E flip into R execute hard-counter your brawling pattern at full build — avoid isolated 1v1s and steal his R in teamfights instead.
edits.after: Echoing Flames leg blasts, a rank-5 Purge that is free and always up, and E into the R execute hard-counter your brawl at full build — avoid isolated 1v1s, steal his R instead.

edits.before: Level 1 is a straight loss — you only have Q and Urgot's shotgun knees deal percent-max-HP on every auto, so walking up to last-hit bleeds you faster than Q can poke him. Play behind the wave, last-hit with Q at max range, and do not contest the cannon. At level 2 E comes online but Urgot's Disdain flip at level 2 or 3 means any E approach risks getting flipped into his shotgun burst — do not hook in unless his E is visibly on cooldown. Stack waves and accept that he owns this early window.
edits.after: Level 1 is a straight loss — you only have Q and Urgot's Echoing Flames (P) adds a leg blast to his autos, so walking up to last-hit bleeds you faster than Q can poke him. Play behind the wave, last-hit with Q at its 775 range, and do not contest the cannon. At level 2 your E comes online, but Disdain shields him as he charges and hurls you into point-blank Purge — do not hook in unless his E is down, and that is a 16-second wait at rank 1. Stack waves and accept that he owns this early window.

edits.before: The lane slightly opens at 6 when you steal Fear Beyond Death, but don't mistake a stolen execute for a win button — Urgot's R only executes targets below 25% HP, and at that HP your W heal is not enough to survive his sustained Purge damage long enough to fear him first. Use the stolen R as a deterrent: the threat of a Sylas-executed Urgot forces him to respect you and step off the wave. Look for the trade pattern where his E is down, hook in with E2, W immediately for the heal, passive-proc your chains, and disengage before shotgun knees ramp up. Never let it become a prolonged brawl.
edits.after: The lane opens at 6 when you steal Fear Beyond Death, but a stolen execute is not a win button — it only finishes him under the threshold, and at that HP your W heal will not outlast his Purge damage long enough to impale him first. Use the stolen R as a deterrent: the threat of a Sylas holding the execute forces him to respect you and step off the wave. Look for the pattern where Disdain is down — 16 seconds at rank 1 — hook in with E2, W immediately for the heal, proc your chains, and disengage before Echoing Flames ramps. Never let it become a prolonged brawl.

edits.before: At two items Urgot's percent-max-HP damage trivialises your W sustain in an isolated 1v1 — even Riftmaker stacks cannot keep pace with true-DPS shotgun knees through a full Purge channel. Your role shifts to teamfight flanker: steal Fear Beyond Death off cooldown every fight, use E2 to hook carries, and let your team's burst do the work his HP stack can't tank. Never duel Urgot alone past 20 minutes; if he Disdains you in a 1v1, you lose.
edits.after: At two items Urgot's sustained damage trivialises your W sustain in an isolated 1v1 — Riftmaker stacks cannot keep pace with Echoing Flames blasts through a full Purge channel, and rank-5 Purge costs him nothing to re-cast. Your role shifts to teamfight flanker: steal Fear Beyond Death off its 70-second cooldown every fight, use E2 to hook carries, and let your team's burst do the work his HP stack can't tank. If he Disdains you in a 1v1, you lose.

edits.before: Walk forward and let shotgun knees (W passive) grind your HP below 50% before flipping with Disdain (E)
edits.after: Walk forward and let Echoing Flames (P) leg blasts grind your HP down before he throws you with Disdain (E)

edits.before: Urgot burns Disdain (Flip) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Urgot burns Disdain (Flip) on nothing — take the sixteen-second invitation.

notes: Packet suspectName for wants.you[2] ('Steal Fear Beyond Death') is a false positive — that is Urgot's real R name. Packet levelChart disagrees with the on-disk chart at rows 0, 4 and 5; I only flipped row 4 (Level 6), where the prose in both layers already described a Sylas advantage. Rows 0 and 5 left alone because the existing whys support Urgot there. The 25% execute threshold figure was removed rather than corrected — Riot's description gives no number and I did not verify one.
